verdict.rationale: Turso's GitHub repo presents libSQL as an "open source, open contribution fork of SQLite" maintained by Turso, and a Turso employee states it is MIT-licensed, so the core engine's source is readable under an open license. Missing for 10: first-party license documentation (the MIT claim comes only from an employee's HN comment, not a cited license file), evidence of whether the Turso Cloud platform and the newer Rust rewrite are also open source, and independent corroboration of the licensing.
